recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of four men seated on a vintage sofa inside a cluttered garage, framed by a white architectural opening, with a glowing neon-style title floating in the dark upper half of the interior space.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the bright white exterior frame and the dark, cluttered garage interior.
The neon glow of the typography provides the primary light source for the upper third of the image.
The subjects are positioned in the lower third, creating a grounded, horizontal weight.
The architectural frame acts as a literal 'window' into the scene.
coreInvariants: Dark interior background with visible clutter

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are seated in the lower-center, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing neon text in the upper center acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the glowing text, move down to the subjects' faces, and then outward to the white frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark space between the text and the subjects provides visual breathing room despite the cluttered environment.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep shadows and dark neutrals (black, brown, navy) inside the garage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Stark white for the outer frame and the neon glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted earth tones and denim blues in the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall, with high value contrast provided by the white elements against the dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight mimicking neon tubing
Double-line or 'inline' effect to simulate gas-filled tubes
Horizontal bars extending from the sides of the secondary text line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Open counters in letters like 'A' and 'B'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with weight and scale variation for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: To capture the tubular, glowing aesthetic of the original lettering.
Provides the base skeleton for the custom neon treatment.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide shot of four men in casual attire sitting on a dark green vintage sofa inside a dark, cluttered garage. The scene is viewed through a thick, weathered white rectangular frame. The lighting should be dim inside with a slight glow from above.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered white text in the upper dark area. Use a rounded, monolinear font with a soft white outer glow to simulate a neon sign. Add horizontal lines flanking the second line of text.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a convincing neon glow?
Is the white frame thick and weathered?
Are the subjects seated in the lower half of the frame?
Is the interior sufficiently dark to make the neon pop?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the band

mustAchieve: Authentic neon light falloff on surrounding surfaces

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic neon tube connections in the lettering.
Ensure the white frame doesn't look like a digital border but a physical structure.
Verify the subjects' expressions are candid and relaxed.
Confirm the horizontal lines in the typography are perfectly aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Place [Subject Group] in a [Dark, Cluttered Interior] viewed through a [White Architectural Frame]. Overlay [Custom Neon Typography] in the upper void using [Rounded Monolinear Strokes] with a [Soft White Glow].
